# Anonymisierer-Tools

> Local tools by Robert Meyer for preparing sensitive content before sharing. The Mac app, iPhone/iPad app, Chrome extension, and Windows app are separate products.

## Products — Deutsch / English

- [Mac DE](https://anonymisierer-tools.de/)
- [Mac EN](https://anonymisierer-tools.de/index_eng.html)
- [iPhone & iPad DE](https://anonymisierer-tools.de/ios/)
- [iPhone & iPad EN](https://anonymisierer-tools.de/ios/index_eng.html)
- [Chrome DE](https://anonymisierer-tools.de/chrome/)
- [Chrome EN](https://anonymisierer-tools.de/chrome/index_eng.html)
- [Windows DE](https://anonymisierer-tools.de/windows/)
- [Windows EN](https://anonymisierer-tools.de/windows/index_eng.html)

Mac: local text and image editing, global shortcuts, optional restoration using a mapping kept in RAM for no more than five minutes. macOS 14 or later. Individual license EUR 9.99; ten licenses EUR 79.90; 25+ on request. Provider checkout prices apply.

iPhone/iPad: native mobile app, separate EUR 9.99 purchase. Text, screenshots, photos, share sheet. PDF content is processed as plain text without retaining PDF layout. Do not assume Mac restoration features are included.

Chrome: free text-focused extension. Optional local Gemini Nano detection when supported. Not equivalent to the Mac app.

Windows: native text app in the Microsoft Store (https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N229VW00Z01). Local processing with regex, built-in NER, and an optional local AI layer (a small in-app model, or Ollama / LM Studio). Tray icon, editor, and Ctrl+Shift+A. Optional clipboard safeguard. Optional restoration of the latest session, kept in RAM for no more than five minutes. x64 and ARM64 builds. Text only: image and screenshot tools from the Apple apps are not included. The optional AI layer is experimental and does not guarantee complete detection. Setup downloads need an internet connection. One-time purchase, EUR 14.99; the Microsoft Store price applies. Not covered by the Mac license.

Automatic detection may miss information. Review results before sharing. Reversible placeholder mapping is pseudonymization, not irreversible anonymization. The Mac website demo uses fixed fictional data, no real AI service or app detection engine.
